text.arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ

baseline.text: Gemiye bindiklerinde, dini yalnız Allah'a özgü kılarak O'na yalvarırlar. Allah onları karaya çıkarıp kurtarınca hemen O'na ortak koşarlar.

findings.text: Gemideki ağır tehlike rakip bağlılık katmanlarını ayırıp teslimiyeti yalnız Allah'a yöneltir; güvenliğe çıkış ise koşullara bağlı bu arılığı yeniden ortaklıkla örter.
Kuru kara, gemide söylenen arı bağlılığın davranışta tutup tutmadığını sınayan bir doğruluk zemini olarak okunabilir; ancak bu anlam doğrudan “kara” kullanımından fazla uzaklaşır.

activation_trace.role: The ship is the literal carrier whose exposure supplies the bounded crisis chamber.
Agitated back-and-forth water supplies the instability that strips away usable supports.
Calling and verbally inclining toward an addressee makes the crisis response relational rather than merely inward.
Purification after admixture makes exclusive devotion a filtered state produced under pressure.
Obedience and submission identify what is temporarily concentrated on God.
Rescue by separation supplies the decisive transfer out of the threatening medium.
Dry land is the literal zone in which ordinary agency and alternatives return.
Partnership restores multiple claimants to an allegiance that had just been singular.

changed_reading.after: The verse is a pressure-filter experiment: unstable passage concentrates address and obedience on one recipient, while restored land agency reopens a portfolio of partners.
changed_reading.before: They pray sincerely during danger and relapse after reaching shore.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ... إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ ... يُشْرِكُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The vessel amid unstable water removes ordinary supports, so address, allegiance, and obedience are filtered to one recipient. Rescue transfers the riders to dry land, where the field of possible partners reopens.

activation_trace.role: Escape from an entanglement casts their professed devotion as an attempted inward disentangling.
Exclusive specification apart from partnership names the devotional separation at issue.
Actual rescue by separation provides the successful bodily counterpart.
Renewed participation marks reattachment after bodily extraction.

changed_reading.after: The sequence compares two extractions: God completes the physical one, but the human clearing of allegiance does not remain complete.
changed_reading.before: Sincerity, rescue, and relapse are three successive facts.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus aligns two separation processes: the riders enact a devotional clearing, and God enacts bodily extraction. Their immediate partnership on land shows that physical release can succeed while durable release of allegiance fails.

activation_trace.role: Riding or taking on an affair supplies entry into a condition, not only mounting a conveyance.
Circular motion supplies the exploratory image of a behavioral return loop.
Habit or customary state lets devotion be tested as condition-dependent practice.
Land is the alternating environmental pole opposite the vessel.
Partnership is the recurrent post-crisis state to which the circuit returns.

changed_reading.after: The verse can model a renewable condition-cycle in which environmental rotation repeatedly rotates the distribution of allegiance.
changed_reading.before: The verse reports one abrupt contradiction between sea and shore.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا ... فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ ... إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The circular branch of the vessel root and the two abrupt condition markers activate a recurrent circuit rather than a single anecdote: enter exposure, concentrate allegiance, exit exposure, redistribute allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Purity after mixture remains a genuine local concentration, but context tests its duration.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the governing distinction between a pressured disclosure and an untested claim.
Repeated assay makes temporal persistence part of what the disclosure must establish.
Affliction supplies a social-pressure case in which declared affiliation changes with perceived danger or aid.
A visible entrance with a concealed exit gives the profession a structure of public entry and latent withdrawal.

changed_reading.after: Emergency sincerity is assay evidence: it truthfully exposes the current hierarchy of dependence, while the shore response separately exposes that the hierarchy was not stabilized.
changed_reading.before: Emergency sincerity is either accepted as true or dismissed as hypocrisy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening assay frame and its pressure-responsive professions revise the focus sincerity from proof of settled identity into a real but local assay state. Crisis reveals what dominates when alternatives fail, while the post-crisis exit reveals what persists.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, pressure-sensitive declarations, and a concealed-exit image; I infer that each condition discloses a locally real allegiance without by itself proving continuity. A live alternative is that the sea declaration is wholly insincere rather than sincere but unstable.
structural_cues: 29:2-3 place professed faith under repeated testing before the focus scene.
29:10-11 juxtapose declarations made under affliction and after aid with the naming of hypocrisy.
The focus itself gives two rapid state disclosures, one in danger and one after rescue.

activation_trace.role: The focus rescue is literal extraction from the maritime threat.
Noah's extraction supplies an earlier successful rescue through the same root.
A ship cutting the face of the water supplies the earlier vessel-rescue template.
Extraction from fire shows that the rescue mechanism is separation from danger, not water-specific escape.
Promised extraction of Lot and his household introduces the boundary of who is carried out.
The repeated household rescue confirms extraction while preserving an explicit exception.

changed_reading.after: Rescue is one member of a repeated extraction technology: it reliably changes location and survival status, while 29:65 isolates its non-guarantee of durable allegiance.
changed_reading.before: The rescue merely ends the sea danger before the relapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier rescues repeatedly separate persons from flood, fire, and a doomed settlement. The focus therefore joins a surah-wide extraction series in which removal from a hazard is demonstrably effective but does not by itself settle the rescued person's later allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated extraction verb across several hazards; I infer that the focus asks what rescue can and cannot transform. A live alternative is that the repetitions only demonstrate divine power and are not meant to distinguish bodily from devotional change.
structural_cues: 29:14-15 pair flood, companions, ship, rescue, and an enduring sign.
29:24 and 29:32-33 repeat rescue across unlike hazards and specify the rescued set.
29:65 repeats rescue but uniquely foregrounds what the beneficiaries do immediately afterward.

activation_trace.role: The literal ship is an actually functioning shelter and carrier during exposure.
Partnership supplies the post-rescue distribution of protective or devotional claims.
The weaving spider supplies the maker of a visibly organized but inadequate refuge.
Dwelling and shelter make reliance architectural rather than merely doctrinal.
Weakness of force marks the substitute shelter's failure under real load.
Calling and inclining verbally links the substitute objects directly to the focus act of calling.
Calling an other besides God supplies the alternative addressee set that partnership repopulates.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Mounted vulnerability strips away layered allegiance.** ر ك ب B001 is mounting and riding, B002 is overlap and superposition, and B003 is undertaking or being burdened by a matter. Riding within the ship places people inside layered support over danger; there they call with exclusive devotion, but rescue to land restores association. I infer that acute burden collapses competing layers of claimed support; the voyage reads as an assay that reveals a latent singular orientation which safety re-covers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:67 provides a land-based analogue to shipboard rescue: secure space amid surrounding seizure. The repeated failure is therefore not confined to sea; granted safety repeatedly gets detached from its giver.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Marine danger strips competing affiliations, while rescue restores the conditions for divided allegiance.** Lexical evidence: `رَكِبُوا`, root `ر ك ب`, `B003` (undertaking and being burdened by a matter); `ٱلْفُلْك`, root `ف ل ك`, `B003` (ship moving on water); `دَعَوُا`, root `د ع و`, `B001` (calling to draw near); `مُخْلِصِين`, root `خ ل ص`, `B001` (purification into unmixed clarity) with `B004` (exclusive separation from sharing); `ٱلدِّين`, root `د ي ن`, `B001` (obedience and submission); and `يُشْرِكُون`, root `ش ر ك`, `B001` (sharing and partnership). Structural cue: shipboard burden yields exclusive submission; deliverance to land triggers an immediate `إِذَا` reversal into partnership. Assigned role: danger removes imagined alternatives; rescue changes the pressure field; partnership re-enters when safety permits. Abductive move: the packet supplies temporal reversal, and I infer that circumstance rather than settled conviction regulates their purity. Reading change: sincerity is shown as situational de-mixing that fails to survive changed conditions.

2. **The dry land tests whether the shipboard word will hold true.** Lexical evidence: `نَجَّاهُم`, root `ن ج و`, `B001` (deliverance by separation), and `ٱلْبَرّ`, root `ب ر ر`, surface-supported `B005` (land and open dry country) with dormant `B001` (truth that makes word or deed hold). Structural cue: rescue transfers them from ship to dry land; association immediately contradicts their prior exclusive submission. Assigned role: land is the new test environment; the truth/holding branch measures continuity between crisis-word and safe-land deed. Abductive move: this is a latent activation: `البر` denotes dry land directly, while the truth branch is awakened by the broken word-deed relation. Reading change: arrival on land becomes an assay of whether declared purity has structural hold.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later confirmation (`29:67`):** Protected sanctuary repeats the same safety-triggered contradiction at communal scale: people inhabit `ء م ن B001` yet attach `ء م ن B002` to voidness. The ship-land reversal is therefore not an isolated episode but a stable pattern of pressure-regulated allegiance.

words.prose: {{ar:يُشْرِكُونَ}} ({{tr:yushrikūna}}) closes the ayah as an ongoing, objectless predicate: there they are, associating.
